name: Polotastic: Sweet Bundles & Unrolling
domain: Place Value Units, Bundling & Concrete Subtraction
competency: Understanding place value as physical groups of ten (Singles, Rolls of 10, Packets of 100) and mastering borrowing by physically unrolling bundles
ncertStandard: Grade 2 & 3 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 8 - Tens and Ones
overview: Children help Pip the sweet shopkeeper manage Polo sweets organized into concrete place-value bundles: loose Singles (Ones), Rolls of 10 (Tens), Packets of 100 (Hundreds), and Cartons of 1000 (Thousands). When children lack enough loose singles to complete an order, they tap a roll to physically unroll it into 10 loose sweets, bridging concrete manipulatives with abstract subtraction.
learningOutcomes: Identify place-value units through concrete manipulatives (1 sweet = One, 1 roll = Ten, 1 packet = Hundred)
Understand borrowing as unrolling 1 Ten into 10 loose Ones (e.g., 42 - 17)
Perform cascading regrouping by unpacking 1 Hundred into 10 Tens, then unrolling 1 Ten (e.g., 204 - 58)
Connect physical bundle manipulation directly to written vertical subtraction

levels.name: Direct Takeaway: 35 - 12
levels.description: 3 rolls + 5 singles. Take away 2 singles and 1 roll = 23

levels.name: Unrolling a Roll: 42 - 17
levels.description: 4 rolls + 2 singles. Unroll 1 roll -> 3 rolls + 12 singles = 25

levels.name: Roll Breaking Challenge: 54 - 28
levels.description: 5 rolls + 4 singles. Unroll 1 roll -> 4 rolls + 14 singles = 26

levels.name: Zero-Roll Cascade: 204 - 58
levels.description: 2 packets + 0 rolls + 4 singles. Unpack packet then unroll roll = 146
